title: Plant Manager
text:
Description:

The Plant Manager is responsible for all Operations employees within the facility. The Plant Manager is also responsible for managing all tasks related to the maintenance of the building. The Plant Manager distributes and monitors the workload within the Operations areas, while maintaining the highest level of quality and productivity possible. The Plant Manager will make sure that all instructions are thoroughly followed, and that accurate documentation is recorded correctly for all work produced. This role will demonstrate highly effective and advanced time management, organizational and planning capabilities, strong attention to efficiency and provide exceptional internal and external customer satisfaction.

Requirements:

Other duties may be assigned as needed.

* Read, interpret, and understand the work order completely and plan work to ensure meeting of customer specifications, including reviewing materials that operators are going to use for as specified on the work order.
* Distribute work to each machine with a focus on how long it should take the operator to complete the assigned work and with a focus on what work is a priority.
* Ensure completion of jobs in a timely manner, meeting quantity requirements and maintaining a high degree of quality in all work performed.
* Effectively communicate status of equipment and work in process to VP-Operations.
* Check daily reports to ensure that reprints are being completed in a timely manner and that work orders are being closed in a timely manner.
* Check daily reports to ensure that all postage receipts are done completely and in a timely manner.
* Run end of shift reports with the use of Clarity and OPALS.
* Work with vendors to maintain equipment regarding preventive maintenance and down machines.
* Make recommendations to improve workflow, quality, efficiency, and safety: in turn reducing operating problems and improving product quality within the manufacturing area.
* Enforce all safety rules are being followed during the operation, maintenance, set-up, changing parts, or any other activity taking place.
* Enforce that no employee ever removes, disables, or otherwise tampers with the function of any safety devices installed on company property or equipment. Notify management immediately if you suspect any safety device to be malfunctioning, broken, or missing.
* Keep accurate records of work performed and materials used in accordance with Content Critical Solutions procedures.
* Enforce the return of all tools and accessories used to their proper location clean and in good condition.
* Enforce that all employees maintain a neat and orderly area. Assist in general housekeeping in common areas.
* Treat coworkers with respect and courtesy.
* Perform all reasonable requests from upper management.
* Read, understand, and comply with all written work instructions.
* Work as a team and participate in Content Critical Solutions efforts to ensure continuous improvement of processes, methodologies, productivity, and quality while reducing costs.
* Manage all tasks related to the maintenance of the building.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* This job has management responsibilities over all Operations employees in the facility.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Able to understand written and verbal instructions in English.
* Able to handle a rapidly paced work environment.

**EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE**

* High School diploma or GED.
* Prior experience working in direct mail manufacturing preferred but not required.
* Prior experience managing a facility preferred but not required.
* Knowledgeable in Microsoft Office Suite.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Ability to read and comprehend instructions, correspondences, and memos.
* Ability to verbally communicate effectively with coworkers and upper management.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS**

* Ability to perform simple addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
